name: opencode
one_liner: A free, open-source alternative to Claude Code or Cursor that lets you chat with an AI in your terminal or a desktop app to write and edit code, using whichever AI model you prefer.
buyer: A developer or small dev team that wants an AI coding assistant without being locked into one vendor's pricing or model, and is comfortable installing developer tools themselves.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer standardizes on it across client projects so they're never locked into one AI provider's pricing changes.
A dev tooling company builds and sells a specialized plugin or agent pack on top of opencode's open architecture.
A bootcamp or training company uses it as the free reference AI coding tool in its curriculum instead of paying for seat licenses.

money_ideas.idea: Sell hosted/managed opencode deployments for teams that want a private, self-hosted AI coding agent without managing the infrastructure.
Build and sell premium desktop-app themes, agent packs, or enterprise SSO/audit add-ons on top of the free core.

steal_this: Package a curated set of opencode agent configs for one specific stack (e.g. Next.js + Postgres) and sell it as a $29 starter kit to developers who don't want to configure it themselves.
